recipe.name: Focaccia Bread Recipe
ingredients: 1.5 teaspoons flaky sea salt (Maldon or Fleur de Sel)
instructions: Combine bread flour, instant yeast, and fine sea salt in a large bowl, keeping the salt and yeast on opposite sides. Add warm water and 2 tablespoons olive oil. Mix with a stiff spatula until a shaggy, sticky dough forms with no dry flour remaining.
Cover the bowl and let the dough rest for 10 minutes to hydrate fully.

Wet your hand and perform a set of stretch-and-folds: reach under the dough, stretch it upward, and fold it over itself. Rotate the bowl 90 degrees and repeat four times. Cover and rest 30 minutes. Repeat this fold-and-rest cycle three more times (four sets total over 2 hours).
Cover the bowl tightly with plastic wrap and refrigerate for 8 to 24 hours.

Pour 3 tablespoons of olive oil into a rimmed half-sheet pan (18x13 inches) or 9x13-inch baking dish. Tip the cold dough into the center. Using oiled fingertips, gently press and stretch the dough toward the edges. If it resists, cover and rest 10 minutes before continuing.
Cover the pan loosely and proof at room temperature for 2 to 4 hours, until the dough is puffy and jiggles when the pan is shaken.
Preheat the oven to 450F with a rack in the lower third for at least 30 minutes.

Drizzle the remaining 2 tablespoons of olive oil over the proofed dough. Press all ten fingertips firmly into the dough to create deep, even dimples across the entire surface. Immediately scatter flaky sea salt and fresh rosemary over the top.
Bake for 20 to 25 minutes, rotating once at the 15-minute mark, until the top is deep golden brown. Lift a corner with a spatula to check that the bottom is browned.
Transfer immediately to a wire rack. Slice and serve warm.
